messages:
lucy_sales: Heads up — reseller 'NorthBridge' (NL) sent a rather unconventional commercial ask to win a govtech POC. They want a blended reseller structure: tiered margin + usage rev-share + a reporting SLA. Tagging @omar_partnerships @sophie_dealdesk for visibility.

omar_partnerships: define "blended" — specifics please. That sounds outside our standard EU rate card (link: https://redwood.company/rate-cards/eu).

lucy_sales: specifics from the partner:
- 35% channel margin for a 60-day POC (one-off)
- If they convert customer to $300k ARR within 10 months, margin steps to 28% for 12 months
- 5% ongoing revenue share on usage above the committed threshold (they want to invoice the customer and remit to us)
- weekly usage reporting requirement and a 48h dispute window

sophie_dealdesk: wow — that mix of margin + rev-share + invoicing flow is complex. We need: margin delta calc, who invoices (partner vs RDW), and whether rev-share affects recognition. Please drop CRM opp id + expected first-year usage.

lucy_sales: CRM opp: RDW-EU-6124. Customer estimated first-year billable tokens ~ 1.2B (roughly $420k list). POC expected $30k. Partner insists they invoice customer for ease of local billing.

rafa_finance: red flags: partner invoicing + rev-share adds AR complexity and revenue recognition exposure. Also MDF/clawback? Are they asking for MDF?

lucy_sales: they want a €12k MDF and prefer monthly invoicing. They propose an MDF clawback if commit not met within 10 months.

matt_ps: PS note — POC requires ~45 eng hours plus a secure staging environment. If partner invoices, we still need SSO + DPA in place before any customer data flows. PS costs either covered by MDF or PS voucher.

omar_partnerships: I'm open to a timeboxed 35% POC margin if all of the following are true: 1) partner signs a binding addendum with the commit + MDF clawback, 2) partner agrees to remit rev-share on a monthly statement with reconciliation rights for Redwood, 3) partner must provide customer PO or signed MSA as proof for post-POC step-up, 4) legal approves invoicing flow & reporting SLA.

sophie_dealdesk: Opening ticket DD-10455 to collect docs/approvals. Please upload: CRM opp, quick margin/rev-share calc, draft addendum language, SOW, and reporting SLA. https://redwood.company/dealdesk/DD-10455 :memo:

deal-bot: Ticket DD-10455 created — status: Open. Awaiting finance + legal + RevOps input.

lucy_sales: quick inline calc for reviewers (rounded):
```
First-year list est: $420,000
POC: $30,000 at 35% margin -> partner takes $10,500
MDF: €12,000 (~$13,000) credited
If commit hit -> 28% margin on $300k -> partner $84,000; Redwood net from committed revenue ~$216,000 before rev-share
Rev-share: 5% on usage > threshold, assume 20% above commit -> extra usage $60k => rev-share $3k annually
Net impact: initial POC delta vs std (20% margin) is roughly -$6k; multi-year picture depends on commit timing and rev-share reconciliation
```

rafa_finance: need a RevOps model with FX, AR flow, and a clause for partner insolvency risk. Also whether MDF is prepaid or reimbursed. Monthly invoicing increases credit risk, require AR contact + quicker disputes SLA.

legal-bot: Flagging legal: invoicing via partner + rev-share + reporting SLA require a reseller addendum + a revenue remittance schedule and audit rights. Expect 3-5 business days for first-pass redline.

omar_partnerships: next steps: 1) get partner to sign proposed addendum (commit + MDF clawback + reporting SLA), 2) finance/RevOps to produce model and AR terms, 3) legal to review reseller invoicing/remittance language, 4) PS to confirm whether MDF covers staging & integration. If all green, we can approve a limited 60-day 35% POC margin and conditional post-POC step-up.

sophie_dealdesk: please upload all artifacts to DD-10455 by EOD so we can fast-track. :rocket:

lucy_sales: will upload SOW, partner draft addendum, and CRM notes to DD-10455 today. I'll also ask partner to confirm invoicing cadence and bank details. Thanks team :pray:
